notes: User collects coins, vinyl records, vintage cameras, and books. Uses Coin Collector’s Assistant for coins and Discogs for records; still seeking camera-inventory software. Owns a 1940s Leica IIIa, 1960s Nikon F, and plans to expand with vintage rangefinders. Interested in models from Leica, Nikon, Canon, Olympus, Contax, and Yashica; advised to inspect condition, rust/corrosion, lenses, rarity, provenance, and completed service estimates. Owns 37 pre-1920 American coins, including a 1915-S Barber quarter, and a 1913 Liberty Head nickel needing appraisal. Interest in error coins includes a recently purchased 1972 doubled die cent needing PCGS or NGC authentication; compare current submission guidelines, attribution, fees, and error-variety expertise. Research notable date errors but independently verify claims and watch for altered/counterfeit coins. Has not specified location; use ANA money.org, CoinShowCalendar.com, local dealers, forums, and camera/antiques events to find shows. Keep records organized by denomination and mint mark. Never clean coins; handle edges with clean hands, use PVC-free inert holders and acid-free materials, and store cool, dry, dark, and secure. Distingui
